entries.689bd00f300f4ba5: The publishing market has continued to shrink over the long term, but the company's revenue has stayed at roughly the same level, moving from ¥3,155 million in the fiscal year ended September 2021 to ¥3,256 million in the fiscal year ended September 2025. entries.775abafce14b560c: The company publishes four magazines: “Kigyō Kaikei,” which covers accounting theory and research on and explanation of accounting standards; “Zeimu Kōhō,” which provides correct legal interpretations and processing guidelines for tax practice; “Junkan Keiri Jōhō,” which provides news and commentary on accounting, taxation, finance, securities and legal affairs; and “Business Hōmu,” which explains corporate legal practice and provides examination information for the Business Law Examination.
entries.855fc209db4b155e: Its basic management policy is "appropriate response to the market," and its basic philosophy is to take part in social activities through the publication of books and magazines on corporate management and to contribute to their development. As a medium- to long-term management strategy, it states that it will work to publish books and magazines that respond promptly to readers' needs while responding to changes in laws, accounting systems, and corporate activities, and that it will pursue long-lived, high-quality, standard books, and work to achieve more appropriate distribution to bookstores in response to the faster return of unsold books. It identifies as challenges to be addressed: securing and developing personnel to plan and develop products with fresh perspectives and sensibilities; planning that accurately captures readers' needs and thorough marketing; strengthening sales of existing titles and responding to changing publishing distribution; responding to the expected chronic rise in production costs; and promoting content digitalization.
